dedupe_keys.name: deliverable d4 1 performance and assessment of drinking water treatment trains for removal of pfas and industrial chemicals

description: Rückbeil, Fiona Elena and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed programme combines adsorbent jar tests, rapid small-scale columns and piloting alongside a large activated-carbon groundwater-treatment plant. Breakthrough curves and usage rates support selection and design of treatment trains. Activated carbons, ion-exchange resins and surface-modified clays show different selectivity and organic-matter competition. Related screening publications have differing substance counts and are retained as parts of the research programme, without asserting identical experiments. Source-described cost analysis is site-dependent, and UV254 is a proposed operational surrogate. The separately implemented DWTDT tool uses laboratory and pilot evidence from this programme. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
